summary: Viking Acquisition Corp. I, a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting entry into Amendment No. 1 to its Business Combination Agreement with NorthStar Earth and Space Inc. (target) and Viking NS Amalgamation Corp. (NewCo). The amendment revises transaction sequencing so that redemption of Viking's public shares occurs before its continuation from the Cayman Islands to Canada and prior to closing; updates mechanics for share/warrant conversions and equity exchanges; and clarifies U.S./Canadian tax treatment. No price, premium, or advisor terms are disclosed. The filing is a standard SPAC business combination amendment—watch for SEC review of the Form F-4 registration statement and shareholder vote timeline.
